#| label: setup-did
#| echo: false
import base64
import time

import polars as pl
import vl_convert as vlc
from great_tables import GT
from IPython.display import publish_display_data


def _as_image(svg: str) -> str:
    """Embed the SVG as an image rather than inline markup.

    Quarto moves sections holding an inline chart that is wider than the text column onto the
    full-width page grid; as an image the chart simply scales with the column.
    """
    encoded = base64.b64encode(svg.encode()).decode()
    return f'<img role="img" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,{encoded}">'


def show_chart(chart, *, facet_width: int | None = None) -> None:
    """Render an Altair chart as inline SVG.

    ``facet_width`` narrows the individual panels of a faceted chart. A faceted chart is as wide as
    all its panels together, and Quarto moves any section holding a figure wider than the text column
    onto the full-width page grid, which visibly shifts the prose in that section.

    Publishing the HTML directly keeps this a single cell output: returning an ``HTML`` object would
    add an empty ``text/plain`` output as well, and Quarto would split the figure into sub-figures.
    """
    spec = chart.to_dict()
    if facet_width is not None and "spec" in spec and isinstance(spec["spec"], dict):
        spec["spec"]["width"] = facet_width
        spec["spec"]["height"] = facet_width
    publish_display_data({"text/html": _as_image(vlc.vegalite_to_svg(spec))})


class timer:
    """Report how long a block took."""

    def __init__(self, label: str) -> None:
        self.label = label

    def __enter__(self) -> "timer":
        self._start = time.perf_counter()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.label}] {time.perf_counter() - self._start:.2f}s")
